title: GET /api/events
description: A server-sent event stream that `lathe serve` keeps open: it starts with a `: connected` comment and an empty `spec:changed` event, then sends a `spec:changed` event whose data is the change as JSON (the tables changed and the read models that read them) whenever the data of a product it shows, or Lathe's own checks, change, and again when the checks' run is ready.
